root_cause.detail: The four non-LLM families (nlinear, dlinear, patchtst, itransformer) load NO pretrained backbone at all: their whole checkpoint IS their own trainable state (11,638 / 22,328 / 359,652 / 313,252 bytes). There is therefore no frozen backbone to exclude, so export_compact() reports frozen_backbone_excluded=False by definition. The Gate asserted that flag must be True, so these four rows failed.

evidence_that_compact_works_on_the_faile.interpretation: compression ratio ~1.0-1.14 is CORRECT here: with no frozen backbone there is nothing to strip; the compact file is reconstruction-complete and verified bit-exact
